Three format papers, 45 printed numbers, recomputed exactly

Every number the GoldenFloat, Golden Ruler and TNF papers print that a rule can recompute, run through exact integer arithmetic in a t27 spec: 34 fit, 8 do not, 3 cannot be checked.

This page sets no cookie and sends nothing anywhere.

Where the numbers come from
  • gHashTag/t27 specs/numeric/paper_claims.t27 (gHashTag/t27#10392): t27c 0.5.2 test-report on the Railway lab, 10 of 10 tests pass, 0 vacuous; tri papers runs the same spec
  • The t27 MCP tool t27_paper_claims (gHashTag/t27-mcp#23), wasm generated from that spec with t27c gen-c and zig 0.16.0, called once on the lab with no filter; every row below is one row of its answer
  • The papers: arXiv:2606.05017v5 (GoldenFloat), arXiv:2606.09686v3 (Golden Ruler), and the TNF paper by Dmitrii Vasilev, 2026-08-11
